manual.note: Most often "manual" is an adjective meaning done by hand: "manual work."

ex: The phone had a defect, so I took it back.
Check the shoes for defects before you buy them.
Is this a defect, or did I break it?
The shop changed my TV because of a defect.
The referee gave him a yellow card.
The players argued with the referee after the goal.
She works as a referee for basketball games.
Why did the referee stop the game?
We went diving near the coral reef.
Diving is my favorite summer activity.
She took a diving course on her vacation.
Can I go diving if I can't swim well?
diving.note: Uncountable. Also jumping into water head first: "a diving board." Say "go diving."

prank.note: "Play a prank on someone", not "make a prank".

ex: A vector has both size and direction.
In math class, we draw a vector as an arrow.
Can you add these two vectors for me?
Wind speed and direction can be shown as a vector.
Milk is rich in minerals like calcium.
Iron is an important mineral for your body.
This rock contains many different minerals.
Do these vitamins have minerals in them too?

hack.note: Most often "hack" is a verb: "Someone hacked my email."

ex: The general gave an order to the soldiers.
He became a general in the army.
The general spoke on TV about the war.
My grandfather was a general in the army.
general.note: Most often "general" is an adjective: "a general idea", "in general".

ex: The panda is eating bamboo at the zoo.
Can we go and see the pandas today?
Pandas live in the mountains of China.
My daughter loves her soft toy panda.

bolt.note: Also a bar that locks a door, and "a bolt of lightning."

ex: The diver swam down to the old ship.
Divers found the lost phone in the lake.
She teaches new divers how to breathe underwater.
How deep can a diver go with this tank?
Each new student at the college gets a tutor.
Ask your tutor if you need help with the course.
My online course has a tutor who answers questions.
I meet my tutor every week to discuss my work.
tutor.note: Most often a "tutor" is a private teacher: "I have a math tutor."

ex: A small asteroid passed close to Earth last night.
Scientists think an asteroid killed the dinosaurs.
Can we see the asteroid without a telescope?
This asteroid is about two miles wide.
This old song was recorded in stereo.
Does this speaker play music in stereo?
You need two speakers to hear the music in stereo.
The movie sounds much better in stereo.
stereo.note: Most often "a stereo" is a music system: "Turn on the stereo."

ex: Human trafficking is a serious crime in every country.
Police rescued twelve victims of human trafficking.
The new law helps fight human trafficking at the border.
Where can victims of trafficking get help?
trafficking.note: Most often about drugs: "drug trafficking." For people, say "human trafficking."

ex: Please send me a fax with the signed contract.
Does your office still have a fax machine?
I got a fax from the bank this morning.
Very few people send faxes these days.
She asked the actor for his autograph.
Can I have your autograph, please?
The fans waited outside the stadium for autographs.
He signed autographs for an hour after the game.

barber.note: "Barbershop" is the place: "I go to the barbershop."

panel.note: Often a group of experts: "a panel of judges", "a panel discussion."

ex: We need to put the antenna on the roof.
The TV antenna broke in the storm.
Can you move the antenna? The picture is bad.
This old radio has a long antenna.

yogurt.note: Usually uncountable: "some yogurt", but "a cup of yogurt".

ex: Ooh la la, you look great in that dress!
Ooh la la, this cake looks really expensive.
He saw the new car and said, "Ooh la la!"
Ooh la la, is that a new watch?
ooh la la.note: A playful, joking way to say something looks fancy or sexy.

ex: The doctor gave me antibiotics for my throat.
Take the antibiotics for seven full days.
Do I need a prescription for these antibiotics?
Antibiotics do not work against a cold.
We had sushi for dinner last night.
She learned to make sushi at home.
This restaurant serves very fresh sushi.
Do you eat sushi with chopsticks?
Pour some syrup on your pancakes.
This cough syrup tastes really bad.
Can I have vanilla syrup in my coffee?
Do you have any maple syrup for the waffles?
A convoy of trucks brought food to the city.
The military convoy moved slowly at night.
The convoy stopped at the border for hours.
Two police cars drove at the front of the convoy.
A courier brought the package this morning.
Can you send the documents by courier?
The courier rang the doorbell twice.
He works as a bike courier in the city.
The two countries signed a peace pact.
The pact between the countries lasted two years.
The leaders broke the pact after a few months.
Is the trade pact good for small businesses?
We had spaghetti with meatballs for dinner.
Cook the spaghetti for ten minutes.
My kids love spaghetti with tomato sauce.
Can I have more spaghetti, please?

metro.note: In the US, "metro" often means a big city area; the trains are usually the "subway."

ex: Our team needs one more dev for the app.
The devs fixed the bug in two days.
Can you ask a dev to check this error?
She works as a web dev for a small company.
dev.note: Short for "developer", a person who writes code.

follower.note: Also a person who supports a leader or a religion: "his loyal followers."

ex: This light bulb uses sixty watts.
How many watts does this microwave use?
The speaker has one hundred watts of power.
Buy a bulb with fewer watts to save energy.
The dog got a parasite from dirty water.
Some parasites live inside other animals.
The doctor found a parasite in his stomach.
Wash fruit well to avoid parasites.

hate.note: Most often "hate" is a verb: "I hate rain."

queer.note: Once an insult; now used with care, mostly by the community itself.

ex: He works on open source in his free time.
Many popular apps are built on open source.
Is this program open source, or do I pay?
Open source means anyone can see and change the code.
The movie was a big hit at the box office.
The film made fifty million dollars at the box office.
How did the new movie do at the box office?
Box office sales were low this summer.
box office.note: Also the place where you buy tickets: "Buy tickets at the box office."

trade union.note: British; in the US say "labor union" or "union".

ex: Our luggage was lost in transit.
We waited three hours in transit at the airport.
Do I need a visa for transit through this country?
The package is still in transit, so please wait.
transit.note: In the US, "transit" most often means buses and trains: "public transit."
